seoTitle: How to Cancel Trello Premium Subscription (2026 Guide)
metaDescription: Cancel or downgrade Trello Premium from the Workspace Billing settings, review your plan and payment details first, and confirm the switch back to free.
intro: Trello bills at the Workspace level, not the individual profile, which is the detail that trips people up when they go looking for a cancel button. It means the option lives inside Workspace Settings rather than your personal account menu, and it means you need admin rights on that Workspace to see it at all. This guide shows where the Billing screen actually is, what it looks like once you're on a paid plan, and the general path from there to downgrading back to free.

steps.heading: Start from your Workspace home
steps.body: Billing is tied to a specific Workspace, so open the Workspace running the Premium plan first — not just any board. From the Workspace home you'll see your boards and, on some accounts, promotional tiles for other Atlassian products like Jira; none of that is what you're after, but it confirms you're looking at the right Workspace before you head into its settings.

image.caption: A Trello Workspace home screen, with the boards belonging to that Workspace listed below the header.

steps.heading: Open Workspace Settings and click Billing
steps.body: In the Workspace sidebar, Billing sits below Boards, Members, Settings, and Power-Ups. Clicking it opens the plan and payment screen for the whole Workspace, including a banner at the top if you're on an active trial, a side-by-side comparison of Standard and Premium pricing, and the payment details on file. This is also the screen you'd use to switch plans in the other direction, so read the plan comparison carefully before you decide — it tells you what you're about to lose, not just what you're paying.

image.caption: The Workspace Billing screen, showing the Standard vs. Premium plan comparison and the payment details on file, with Billing highlighted in the left sidebar.

steps.heading: Check your renewal date and seat count first
steps.body: Before changing anything, note your next billing date and how many seats you're being charged for — both are shown on this same screen. Cancelling doesn't refund time already paid for on most plans, so if you're mid-cycle it's often better to let the current period run out and downgrade to take effect at renewal rather than cutting it off immediately.

steps.heading: Find the downgrade or cancel link
steps.body: The actual cancel action isn't part of the plan comparison box — it's a smaller link further down the same Billing page, below the plan and payment sections, usually labeled something like Cancel or Downgrade. It's easy to miss on a first pass because it's deliberately understated compared to the upgrade buttons above it.

steps.heading: Get through the retention screens
steps.body: Clicking that link typically leads to a short sequence of screens asking why you're leaving and offering a discount or a plan swap before it lets you finish. None of these are required — you can decline each one and continue straight to the cancellation confirmation if a lower price isn't what changes your mind.

steps.heading: Confirm the downgrade and verify your data
steps.body: After confirming, check your Workspace settings for a message stating the plan will end on a specific date rather than immediately — Trello generally lets a cancelled plan run out the paid period instead of cutting features off the same day. Your boards and cards stay exactly as they are; only Premium-only features like advanced views become unavailable once the Workspace actually reverts to the free tier.

faq.question: Will I lose my boards if I cancel Trello Premium?
faq.answer: No. Your boards and cards stay intact — downgrading only removes access to Premium-only features, it doesn't delete data.

faq.question: Who can cancel a Trello Premium subscription?
faq.answer: Only Workspace Administrators can see and use the Billing settings needed to cancel or downgrade a plan, since billing is managed at the Workspace level, not the personal account level.

faq.question: What features will I lose after downgrading?
faq.answer: Premium-only views and tools — things like advanced board views and unlimited Power-Ups — typically deactivate once the Workspace reverts to the free tier.

faq.question: Does cancelling take effect immediately?
faq.answer: Usually not. Most cancellations let the current paid period run out, with the plan reverting to free on your next billing date rather than the moment you cancel.

faq.question: Do I have to accept a discount offer to finish cancelling?
faq.answer: No. The retention screens you'll see before the final confirmation are optional — you can decline each one and proceed straight to cancelling.
